/* ===== 메뉴 데이터 ===== */ const menuData = [ { label: "이미지/디자인 도구", children: [ { label: "Image Meta", path: "/image/meta", icon: "photo", desc: "EXIF/ICC 등 이미지 메타데이터 확인/내보내기" }, { label: "Color Explorer", path: "/tools/color-explorer", icon: "photo", desc: "팔레트 생성/대비(AA/AAA) 검사, CSS/JSON 내보내기" }, { label: "Pixel Dot", path: "/image/pixel-dot", icon: "photo", desc: "격자 기반 픽셀 드로잉, PNG/JSON 저장" }, ]}, { label: "데이터 변환/개발 도구", children: [ { label: "Excel → Json", path: "/dev-tools/convert/excel-to-json", icon: "code", desc: "엑셀 시트를 JSON 배열로 생성" }, { label: "Json → Excel", path: "/dev-tools/convert/json-to-excel", icon: "code", desc: "JSON 배열을 XLSX로 생성" }, { label: "Json → Java", path: "/dev-tools/convert/json-to-java", icon: "code", desc: "JSON POJO/record 생성" }, { label: "Json → TypeScript", path: "/dev-tools/convert/json-to-ts", icon: "code", desc: "JSON → TS 인터페이스/타입 생성" }, { label: "Json → Dart", path: "/dev-tools/convert/json-to-dart", icon: "code", desc: "Dart 모델 생성(Freezed/JsonSerializable)" }, { label: "Table Spec", path: "/dev-tools/database/table-spec", icon: "table_chart", desc: "테이블 스펙 정의/문서화 보조" }, ]}, { label: "개발 & 보안 툴", children: [ { label: "Git Log Viewer", path: "/viewer/git-log", icon: "history", desc: "git 로그 탐색 및 시각화" }, { label: "Crypto", path: "/dev-tools/crypto", icon: "code", desc: "SHA-256, AES-GCM 등 해시/암·복호화" }, ]}, { label: "편의 도구", children: [ { label: "QR Maker", path: "/tools/qr-maker", icon: "qr_code", desc: "텍스트/URL QR 이미지 생성, PNG/SVG 저장" }, ]}, { label: "게임", children: [ { label: "Image Puzzle", path: "/game/image-puzzle", icon: "grid_4x4", desc: "업로드 이미지로 퍼즐 플레이" }, { label: "Mabinogi Craft", path: "/game/mabinogi-craft", icon: "grid_4x4", desc: "마비노기 크래프트(샌드박스)" }, ]} ]; const rootEl = document.getElementById('root'); const landingShell = document.getElementById('landing-shell'); const tabsEl = document.getElementById('tabs'); const rowsEl = document.getElementById('rows'); const yearEl = document.getElementById('year'); const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput'); yearEl.textContent = String(new Date().getFullYear()); let activeTab = 0; const guidePath = (p) => p.endsWith('/') ? p + 'guide/' : p + '/guide/'; function renderTabs(){ tabsEl.innerHTML = ''; menuData.forEach((g, idx) => { const el = document.createElement('span'); el.className = 'tab' + (idx === activeTab ? ' active' : ''); el.textContent = g.label; el.tabIndex = 0; el.addEventListener('click', () => { activeTab = idx; renderRows(); highlightTab(); }); el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); activeTab = idx; renderRows(); highlightTab(); } }); tabsEl.appendChild(el); }); highlightTab(); } function highlightTab(){ [...tabsEl.children].forEach((c,i)=> c.className = 'tab' + (i===activeTab?' active':'')); } function matchQuery(item, q){ return (item.label + ' ' + (item.path || '') + ' ' + (item.desc || '')) .toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()); } function renderRows(){ const q = searchInput.value.trim(); rowsEl.innerHTML = ''; const items = q ? menuData.flatMap(g => g.children).filter(it => matchQuery(it, q)) : (menuData[activeTab]?.children || []); if(items.length === 0){ const p = document.createElement('p'); p.textContent = q ? '검색 결과가 없습니다.' : '메뉴가 없습니다.'; p.style.opacity = .7; rowsEl.appendChild(p); return; } items.forEach((it) => { const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'row'; // 상단: 아이콘 + 제목 + 버튼 const head = document.createElement('div'); head.className = 'row-head'; const headLink = document.createElement('a'); headLink.className = 'row-head-link'; headLink.href = it.path; headLink.setAttribute('data-run', it.path); headLink.setAttribute('aria-label', it.label + ' 실행'); const icon = document.createElement('span'); icon.className = 'row-icon'; icon.innerHTML = `${it.icon || 'widgets'}`; const title = document.createElement('span'); title.className = 'row-title'; title.textContent = it.label; const acts = document.createElement('span'); acts.className = 'row-acts'; const guide = document.createElement('a'); guide.className = 'link'; guide.textContent = '가이드'; guide.href = guidePath(it.path); const exec = document.createElement('a'); exec.className = 'link primary'; exec.textContent = '실행'; exec.href = it.path; exec.setAttribute('data-run', it.path); acts.appendChild(guide); acts.appendChild(exec); head.appendChild(headLink); headLink.appendChild(icon); headLink.appendChild(title); head.appendChild(acts); // 하단: 설명 const desc = document.createElement('div'); desc.className = 'row-desc'; desc.textContent = it.desc || ''; row.appendChild(head); if (it.desc) row.appendChild(desc); rowsEl.appendChild(row); }); attachRunHandlers(rowsEl); } /* ←←← ✅ renderRows 닫힘 */ function attachRunHandlers(scope=document){ scope.querySelectorAll('[data-run]').forEach((el) => { el.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const path = el.getAttribute('data-run') || '/'; runSpa(path); }); }); } function renderAll(){ renderTabs(); renderRows(); } renderAll(); searchInput.addEventListener('input', renderRows); // ===== SPA 전환기 ===== async function runSpa(routePath = location.pathname) { if (landingShell) landingShell.style.display = 'none'; rootEl.style.display = 'block'; if (!window.__SPA_BOOTSTRAPPED__) { window.__SPA_BOOTSTRAPPED__ = true; await import('/src/main.tsx'); } if (routePath && routePath !== location.pathname) { history.replaceState({}, '', routePath); window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')); } } // 비루트 직진입 → SPA만 표시 const isRoot = location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/index.html'; if (!isRoot) runSpa(location.pathname); // “메뉴 열기” document.getElementById('openAppBtn')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); runSpa('/'); });
